subject: GEOGRAPHY
description: ICSE 10th Geography: Forests, Water Resources, Minerals (Iron, Coal, Petroleum), Cash Crops and Food Crops

questions.question: Which tidal mangrove tree species dominates the Sundarbans in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Sundari trees (Heritiera fomes) thrive in littoral tidal swamps and lend their name to the Sundarbans.

questions.question: Which method of surface irrigation is most traditional and widely practiced in peninsular India with hard rock?
questions.explanation: Tank irrigation is predominant in South India due to undulating rocky terrain where digging wells is hard.

questions.question: Which variety of coal has the highest carbon content and energy output?
questions.explanation: Anthracite is the finest grade of coal, containing over 85-90% carbon content.

questions.question: Which state is the leading producer of sugarcane in India?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh has the largest acreage and highest total output of sugarcane in India.

questions.question: What kind of farming involves cultivating cash crops like tea and coffee over large estates?
questions.explanation: Plantation agriculture involves single-crop large estates managed with high capital and labor.
